scene: Inferno VI — Cerberus, rain and Ciacco
story: Dante regains consciousness in the third circle under cold, foul, continuous rain mixed with hail and snow
Cerberus, the three-headed guardian, attacks and blocks the path
Virgil casts handfuls of earth into Cerberus's open mouths, diverting the guardian
Dante and Virgil proceed across the muddy ground
Ciacco recognizes Dante and speaks about division and the future of Florence
Ciacco returns to the mud; Dante and Virgil continue toward Plutus
